products.summary: Rigorous Swiss grid monograph exploring typography, asymmetry, and modern structures.
products.description: An experimental 120-page design publication paying homage to Josef Müller-Brockmann and modern graphic syntax. Crafted custom type specimen layouts, dual-color duotone imagery, poster inserts, and screen-printed jacket.

products.summary: Full-bleed responsive layout with smooth transitions, analytics engine, and client inquiry portal.
products.description: The contemporary digital portfolio framework built to display high-resolution creative works seamlessly on both mobile smartphones and ultra-wide desktop monitors, featuring real-time view tracking and client inquiry management.
